name: Aria Starr
life: “I still remember bringing my last flat's key to a family supper.” People around the market by Market Flats know Aria by a small Thursday habit. Aria often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I can finally afford to move home and did not know somebody else had spent a life there.
appearance: Aria has dark brown curls cut close behind the ears, a straight nose and deep-set eyes, and a favorite piece of clothing, a brown corduroy jacket. It usually goes with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. When somebody else has the floor, Aria listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Aria gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Aria privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To find secure housing after the breakup.
family: Milan Gray is Aria’s cousin. Aria picks the meeting place. Milan sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *Names on the night wall*, Milan says, “I put down the cleaner who sits on the steps until my taxi comes.”
connections: Tariq Hamilton (sibling). Siblings have to hear the same old voicemail before arguing over who was promised the house.
